text: The road narrows beside a hamlet well. A cart lies on its side. Beyond it, a house burns.

speaker: Road Warden
text: Raiders. Keep behind the wagon. I need to get these people off the road.
A child is trapped against the well by the overturned cart. A brigand with an axe closes the distance.

speaker: Kai
text: There’s a child by the well.

speaker: Road Warden
text: I see her. Wait until I can—
Kai is already running. The brigand turns toward him instead.

speaker: Kai
text: Hey! Over here!
Beside the well, a young woman in blue steps between the child and the axe. She raises a lance.

speaker: Lancer
text: Down, behind me. Do not run until I say.

speaker: Kai
text: I can get the cart out of her way!

speaker: Lancer
text: And leave yourself exposed to the next man. Hold the well side!
A rider in crimson pulls up hard at the edge of the square. He sees the axe, the child, and the strangers trying to help.

speaker: Rider
text: You there! Axe in hand! Try somebody who can fight back!
His horse rears against a loose market awning. The rider catches the reins a heartbeat too late.

speaker: Rider
text: Ah. Bad entrance. Sorry!

speaker: Lancer
text: Then make a better second one. Keep that lane clear!
From the steps above the square, another traveler points toward a gap between two cottages.

speaker: Traveler
text: The cart is not the only problem. Two more are coming around the crates. Take the child through the fence lane instead.

speaker: Kai
text: You’ve been watching them?

speaker: Traveler
text: Since before you shouted at one. Go.
Kai braces the cart long enough for the child to slip through. For an instant, a fine green light crosses the mark above his left brow. It vanishes before he notices.
The woman on the steps notices. She says nothing.

speaker: Road Warden
text: I have her! The families are clear of the western lane!

speaker: Lancer
text: Good. Then we keep the raiders from following.

speaker: Rider
text: Well. I was heading to Vael, but I can spare a few minutes for this.

speaker: Kai
text: Whoever you are, thank you. Now—please—help me finish it.

speaker: Traveler
text: The chief is holding back by the far road. Take away his men, and he has nowhere to send them.
Four strangers turn toward the raiders. The child is safe. The road is not.
